versions.changelog:
next-step-tracker 0.1.2

- Updated for Cargo project v0.17.0: instructions and directory structure now reference "project" rather than "CDK" throughout.
- Improved alignment of documentation (README.md, SKILL.md, evals) to reflect current install and integration guidance.
- Revised skill setup flow for clarity and new commands (`cargo-ai project add`, `project init`, etc.).
- Minor edits for conciseness and consistency.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.

- Shortens and clarifies the SKILL.md description and overview for better readability.
- Removes redundant sections and streamlines installation and setup instructions.
- No changes to functionality or behavior.
- Deletes obsolete skill-card.md file as part of documentation cleanup.

Initial public release.

- Tracks and records promises made on sales calls from the call log, capturing both team and customer commitments.
- Automatically closes commitments when matched follow-up activity is found in the activity log.
- Posts due and overdue commitments to Slack, grouped by owner, with clear follow-up actions.
- Native model support provided; CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio) available via adaptation.
- Read-only operation on your repository; no changes made to call logs or activities.
- Includes clear installation and adaptation instructions for seamless integration into your sales workflow.
